long_description:
🕉️ What is Kirtan? ✨

Kirtan is an ancient sacred practice of mantra chanting, where voices, music, and hearts come together in Divine vibration.

Through call-and-response chanting, we repeat sacred Sanskrit mantras, allowing the mind to become quiet and the heart to open.

You don’t need to know how to sing or understand Sanskrit. Just bring your beautiful self and allow the music to carry you.

Kirtan is a form of Bhakti Yoga, the yoga of love and devotion. ❤️

When we chant together, we create something magical. Our individual voices become one, reminding us that we are all connected.

✨ Come experience the joy, peace, and high vibrations of Kirtan!

Saturday, November 14

7:00–9:00 pm | $20

With The KC Kirtan Band

At InBliss Yoga

Bring a friend and let your soul sing! 🎶
